name: Battle for Dream Island
overview: Battle for Dream Island is an American reality TV viewer-voting animated web series created by Michael Huang and Cary Huang, who are most known by their YouTube channel name, jacknjellify. The series is about a competition between inanimate, anthropomorphic objects. It premiered on January 1, 2010, and is currently airing its fifth and sixth seasons, as well as a revival of its second season. The entire series is uploaded on YouTube, on the channel jacknjellify.
